meta.name: Product mix
meta.description: A workshop makes chairs (£45 profit each) and tables (£80 each) from 400 units of wood and 450 hours of labour a week: a chair takes 5 units of wood and 10 hours, a table 20 units and 15 hours. Maximizing the profit gives 24 chairs and 14 tables, £2,200, with both limits used up: the product mix benchmark (benchmarks/product_mix), whose optimum the four corners of the feasible region prove.
